changes.name: codex
changes.headline: Fullscreen transcripts, voice and usage tools
changes.detail: The 0.155–0.157 releases add /usage analytics, voice controls, fuller worktree workflows, GPT-6 Sol/Luna support and improved tmux behavior.
changes.caution: Fullscreen transcripts and eligible background-server startup are enabled by default in 0.157. Restart Codex after activation. The Nix-installed binary continues to be updated through this flake.

changes.name: curl
changes.description: Command line tool for transferring files with URL syntax
changes.headline: HTTP message signing; legacy TLS-SRP removed
changes.detail: Adds RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures and the --httpsig-* CLI options, plus transport and authentication fixes.
changes.caution: TLS-SRP support is removed, and SPNEGO no longer falls back to NTLM. Check scripts or endpoints depending on either behavior.

changes.name: fd
changes.description: Simple, fast and user-friendly alternative to find
changes.role: On asterix: supplied by the nixCats Neovim configuration.
changes.headline: Exact filename matching
changes.detail: Adds --exact and --ignore-parent. Terminal output sanitizes control characters and filename-direction overrides.
changes.caution: --exec-batch now rejects a placeholder as its executable. Ordinary --exec still permits that form.

changes.name: findutils
changes.description: GNU Find Utilities, the basic directory searching utilities of the GNU operating system
changes.headline: find -mount now skips mount-point entries
changes.detail: Improved directory-race handling and regex character classes. xargs reports execution failures more clearly.
changes.caution: Use -xdev if scripts must still include the mount-point entry. -execdir / -okdir no longer accept {} as the executable, and an -exec ... + terminator must follow a standalone {} argument.

changes.name: gh
changes.description: GitHub CLI tool
changes.headline: Worktree checkout and issue/PR attachments
changes.detail: Adds --worktree to PR checkout and issue develop, media attachments to issues/PRs/comments, semantic issue search and named project fields.
changes.caution: Authentication flows now copy device codes to the clipboard by default; gh config set clipboard disabled opts out. Includes fixes for terminal escapes, token redaction and Codespaces port binding.

changes.name: herdr
changes.headline: Remote CLI control and steadier SSH sessions
changes.detail: Use herdr --machine to control saved SSH machines. Inputs gain cursor editing, and remote panes use less bandwidth and recover more smoothly.
changes.caution: Remote CLI forwarding requires this update on both ends. Stalled terminal observers now disconnect after 30 seconds; their panes continue running.

changes.name: lazygit
changes.description: Simple terminal UI for git commands
changes.role: On asterix: supplied by the nixCats Neovim configuration.
changes.headline: PR check status and smoother worktree workflows
changes.detail: 0.64 reworks concurrency and shows GitHub PR checks. 0.65 improves conflict selection and adds branch-name filtering in the worktree pane.
changes.caution: Custom pager configuration is reworked as diff-renderer configuration. Review any custom pager settings when upgrading.

changes.name: libressl
changes.description: Utility which reads and writes data across network connections — LibreSSL implementation
changes.headline: Hybrid post-quantum TLS key exchange
changes.detail: The 4.3 line adds MLKEM768_X25519 TLS key shares, ML-KEM benchmarks and Sieve STARTTLS support.
changes.caution: Several obsolete BN_* macros are removed. openssl cms no longer accepts -compress / -uncompress. Rebuild custom consumers against the new headers.

changes.name: lima
changes.description: Linux virtual machines with automatic file sharing and port forwarding
changes.headline: Headless Mac support and better VM controls
changes.detail: Adds LaunchDaemon support on macOS, screenshots, restart-time edit flags and experimental Windows guests.
changes.caution: socket_vmnet access is restricted to the admin group. Separately, this repo recreates its Rosetta VM when the guest image changes, so the first Linux build after activation may take several minutes.

changes.name: markdownlint-cli2
changes.role: Bundled into the nixCats Neovim environment; not a global Homebrew/mise upgrade.
changes.headline: Per-file configuration overrides
changes.detail: Adds the overrides option, improves configuration handling, and reports attempted fix counts.
changes.caution: Node 20 support is removed. The Nix wrapper supplies its own runtime; check separately installed project copies.

changes.name: nano
changes.description: Small, user-friendly console text editor
changes.headline: New-buffer aliases and restored search shortcuts
changes.detail: Adds --newbuffer / set newbuffer as clearer aliases and restores legacy Ctrl-W Ctrl-T and Ctrl-/ Ctrl-T combinations.
changes.caution: Nano now refuses to start when standard output is not a terminal.

changes.name: openssh
changes.description: Implementation of the SSH protocol
changes.headline: Authentication diagnostics and security fixes
changes.detail: ssh -Z shows the ordered authentication keys. FIDO key flags become editable during passphrase changes; agent forwarding and restricted tunnel handling receive fixes.
changes.caution: Portable OpenSSH now requires ECC, including NIST P-521, in libcrypto. This is mainly a constraint for custom crypto builds; NixOS evaluations succeeded.

changes.name: pi-coding-agent
changes.headline: Cache warming and richer context hooks
changes.detail: 0.86 adds prompt-cache warming, /bug reports and per-model compaction budgets. 0.87 adds context-edit entries and full-transcript extension hooks; 0.87.1 expands model support.
changes.caution: Custom providers must adopt TranscriptContext. Extensions must handle new event shapes; shouldStopAfterTurn is replaced by finishTurn. user_bash errors now abort instead of falling through.

changes.name: prometheus
changes.description: Service monitoring system and time series database
changes.headline: Stable duration expressions and first_over_time
changes.detail: Adds Oracle Cloud discovery, experimental start-timestamp-aware rates, and faster queries and histogram parsing.
changes.caution: Hetzner hcloud discovery drops __meta_hetzner_datacenter. Nonstandard stats query values now warn and will be rejected in a future major release. Review affected rules or API clients on bench-obs.

changes.name: rrsync
changes.description: Helper to run rsync-only environments from ssh-logins
changes.headline: Restricted-root paths fixed in 3.5.1
changes.detail: The restricted SSH wrapper now includes the 3.5.1 root-relative path fixes, alongside the 3.5 security hardening. Arkisto inherits the same pinned rsync source and binary.
changes.caution: Unsafe-option restrictions from the 3.5 line remain. The packaged rsync tests exercise restricted-root paths; no live archive transfer or host deployment was performed.

changes.name: rsync
changes.description: Fast incremental file transfer utility
changes.headline: Path-handling regressions fixed in 3.5.1
changes.detail: Adds the 3.5.1 fixes for symlinked sender ancestors, operator-supplied --files-from paths and descriptor streams, while retaining 3.5 security hardening. Protocol 33 adds logical-block statistics.
changes.caution: The 3.5 line still enforces stricter path confinement. The known 3.5.0 regressions are fixed here through a source-pinned overlay; the base nixpkgs snapshot remains September 20.
changes.role: On asterix: the session-sync job and Rosetta guest. A separately installed Homebrew rsync is outside this configuration.
